name: week
description: The week from the person's own records: what is coming up, the tasks due in the next seven days, and the habits being kept up.

use.when: the person wants to plan or see their week: appointments, things to do, what they keep up.
use.not: a single event, which is a calendar block, or a plain list of tasks with no dates, which is a collection of tasks.
use.with: the events and tasks as records, made with create_record from what the person says, so each is on its own page too and shows here.
